discovery.title: From screens in class to smart glasses, Norway rethinks new technologies
discovery.summary: Three years ago, a schoolteacher in Norway was reprimanded for putting his pupils' iPads aside to return to pen and paper. Now, the whole country is rethinking its approach to new technologies.
